IND behavioral_signals rank family (consecutive_return_streak_length / chronological_return_sequence_correlation) is IS-complete but prod-pinned: 9 measured constructions (ts_mean win1/5/22/66, ts_decay_linear, ts_rank/zscore/delta, ts_corr; group_rank axis market/industry/sector/subindustry; decay 1/4/8/10/20; STATISTICAL vs SUBINDUSTRY; trade_when event gates) all pass every IS gate (S 2.0-2.4, F 1.15-1.25, 2Y 1.71-2.44, robust 1.06-1.53, checks.fail=[]) yet prod = 0.7161-0.8261. One book alpha family pins it. Do NOT expand this family in IND; rank normalization is mandatory (group_neutralize/group_zscore collapse S to 0.39-1.33).

IND low-alphaCount white spaces are DEAD as of 2026-10-03: pv70/event_relation (relation network, ac0-1, S0.13-0.14), model176 (ESG/employee, ac0-8, cov0.4, S-0.24~0.93), quant_factor_lib (credit risk factors, ac1-81, S-1.36~0.84 + TO0.45-0.72 all fail), analyst45 (analyst idea, ac0-466, S-0.76~1.25). Low usage only loosens the prod wall, it does NOT guarantee IS strength - both conditions must hold.

IND mean_flash_estimate_eps family (ANALYST tower 1.4x, prod 0.5707/0.5898 clean) is DEAD on robust_universe_sharpe 0.58-0.77: tried all group axes, decay 4/8/16, STATISTICAL vs SUBINDUSTRY, group_neutralize/zscore, and 4 denominator conventions (div|eps|, div std_dev, div delayed eps, ts_zscore). Best 2Y ever reached 2.72 with S2.19/F1.63 but robust stayed 0.74. Family-level dead end.

IND denominator/neutralization/axis tricks are FAMILY-SPECIFIC, not portable: KOR's divide-denominator trick lifted self+prod by 0.12 each, but the same family in IND moved robust by 0.00. Same class as 'group axis is not a universal SUB-gate knob'.
